evidence:
Scoped row 43 pass, not task clearance. Frozen task tests/scoring.toml:1-11 lists render=0.0 and constraints=0.0 under gates only; the only reward weights are functional=.6, polish=.2, visual=.2, and functional floor=.05. These bytes, score.py and test.sh are identical to the frozen template. Gate criterion weight=1.0 in each all_pass/binary judge.toml is internal aggregation, not reward mass. tests/tools/score.py:40-48 checks both gate scores >0, ignores scored inputs when a gate fails, computes the weighted sum only from scored dimensions, and requires functional >.05 before paying it. It returns status 1 for gate failure at line 83. tests/test.sh:212-227 removes old scored output, runs gates and scorer first, exits on scorer status 1 (or writes zero and exits for errors), and reaches run_suite scored only on status 0.
Actual execution of the unchanged frozen scorer on nine synthetic dimension-input cases is recorded in per-row-review/evidence/43-scorer.json (SHA256 997f4f377fba4cf33dd4f45a86b772173757ae0fc2e79985897cfa651dfb0524). Either failed gate with maximum downstream inputs returned exit 1/reward 0 and marked scored dimensions skipped. Gates-only inputs returned reward 0. Functional 0, .049 and .05 with polish=visual=1 returned reward 0 despite weighted_score .4, .4294 and .43; .051 returned .4306. Functional=1 with no presentation credit returned .6; all-max returned 1. This tests the scorer's policy boundary, not a configured judge or the entire shell.
Concrete dead-app challenges: a visually complete editor with a no-op Run cannot satisfy gates/render/judge.toml:25-29, which demands a newly authored marker in both actual preview and console. A static seed response, no-op successful POST or localStorage-only library cannot satisfy gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-31, which demands a new UI save and identity/title/filename/exact-source readback in an independent clean context, then reload. These are source-level counterexample analyses, not executed weak-app judge runs. A conforming alternative with different control labels, a drawer library and server-rendered record data remains accepted: the render criterion matches control purpose; the constraints criterion expressly permits server-rendered data and does not require a separate JSON endpoint. app_context.md's Auto-run preparation also prevents a missing convenience toggle alone from wrongly failing these basic gates. Ordinary feature failures remain local in scored prompts; a genuinely failed global prerequisite zeroes Functional/Polish and uses Visual anchor 1 (normalized zero).
All 21 raw-index artifact hashes matched. Its surface report is scripted product evidence only; neither it nor this scorer fixture establishes a configured judge score, complete verifier launch, Oracle result or empirical weak-app ranking. Those separately required task-wide measurements remain unwaived and outside this row's narrow policy verification.
